svg.text: HIP text path. Left column is the pipeline. Right column is what checks it.

g.text: 1. Turn arrives
2. Intent classified
3. Subject resolved
4. Injection contract runs
5. Facts opened by key class
6. Prompt assembled
7. Model generates
8. Output checked
9. Record written
Text query with an authenticated identity. Identity is possession of the device keypair.
intent_classifier.py. Below threshold falls through to knowledge, the most permissive state.
subject_resolution.py. Unscored and ungated. Over-match of a same-named entity is not caught.
injection_contract.py, INJ-1 through INJ-7. Produces injection_result.allowed.
partition_crypto. Member, pair, care-team, household-circle. Label never grants access, roster does.
local_system_prompt, four render sites. Returns rendered_fact_ids. hot_context is not instrumented.
Groq or local Ollama. The model words the reply; it does not decide disclosure.
G0 runs only when reply_source is model. Every other exit is a deterministic template.
admitted[], prompt_fact_ids, resolved_subjects. IDs and metadata, never fact values.
INJ-1..7 discrepancy checks
PS1, PS2, DK1-4, OB4, OB5
PSA1
G0
Assert against the record, not against the prompt.
No server-side path opens a fact. Master key destroyed.
prompt_fact_ids must be a subset of admitted. Built and wired in.
Reply names a tracked person while nothing was admitted. Hard zero.

svg.text: Known gaps: hot_context is live on the voice path and uncovered. Voice conversation history carries no fact IDs. known_facts bypasses the contract if a caller repopulates it (D-27).
